Relatively safer day Average night

In detail

North Yorkshire Police recorded 193 crimes inside this ward's official boundary over the 3 months to July 2026 — 4.8 per 1,000 residents, the 8th highest rate of York's 21 wards. The daytime score here is driven by shoplifting (3), vehicle crime (2), burglary (1); the evening/night score by anti social behaviour (25), violent crime (18), public order (3). Rated against the average of the city's own wards, never against another city.

Frequently asked questions

Is Heworth safe?

Wandroz currently rates Heworth in York as relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in York during the day and roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in York at night. This rating is derived from North Yorkshire Police street-level crime records published at data.police.uk — an official statistic, not an assessment. High-footfall tourist, transit or shopping areas can read higher on this kind of measure without that meaning elevated risk per visit, since these statistics are normalised against registered residents rather than footfall — see the note on this page and the methodology page for the full caveats.

Is Heworth safe at night?

At night, Heworth is rated as roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in York. If you're unsure, it's worth checking recent local reviews for your specific street or block, since a neighbourhood-wide rating can't capture block-by-block variation.

Is Heworth a good area to stay in as a tourist?

Heworth's day rating (relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in York) is the more relevant one for typical daytime tourist activity; check the night rating too if you'll be out late. You can search accommodation already filtered to this specific area using the Booking.com link on this page.
